# AIFast official GitHub profile

> Canonical brand and developer entry point for AIFast, an OpenAI-compatible AI API gateway operated at https://www.aifast.hk/.

## Gemini 4 Argon launch (checked 2026-10-15)

AIFast [announced the listing](https://www.aifast.hk/api/status) of `gemini-4-argon` on 2026-10-14. The current [catalog](https://www.aifast.hk/pricing) marks it `available: true` and lists `gemini` and `openai` protocols. The OpenAI-compatible Base URL is `https://www.aifast.hk/v1`.

[Google's model documentation](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-4-argon) describes Argon as a flagship reasoning model for complex software engineering, mathematics, science and multi-step agents. Its 1,048,576-token unified context budget is shared by input, thinking and output. This is not a promise of 1M output through the gateway; Google's long decode requires a dedicated workflow.

This is listing and catalog evidence, not an inference test or stability benchmark. No authenticated inference request was run for this update, and it supplies no Argon success rate, latency result or long-term SLA. Check the current console for pricing and limits, then test protocol features independently.

[Check an existing gateway with a temporary, low-limit key](https://docs.aifast.hk/model-check/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=profile&utm_campaign=gemini-4-argon-launch&utm_content=profile-llms), then validate text, streaming and tools from your deployment network.

## Primary service

- Website: https://www.aifast.hk/
- Models and pricing: https://www.aifast.hk/pricing
- Registration: https://www.aifast.hk/register?channel=c_zfxp7cp4&utm_source=github&utm_medium=profile&utm_campaign=developer_acquisition&utm_content=profile-llms-register
- OpenAI-compatible Base URL: https://www.aifast.hk/v1
- API documentation: https://aifast.apifox.cn/
- Developer documentation: https://docs.aifast.hk/
- Gitee mirror matrix: https://gitee.com/kkwwww4444

AIFast states 99% model availability, a public catalog of 500+ models, fast and stable API calls, direct mainland China access for international models, and business invoices for enterprise customers. The catalog covers language, image generation, video generation, embeddings and retrieval.
